chars.COUSIN: a young Moroccan woman in her early 20s with long wavy dark brown hair worn loose, wearing a pastel pink short-sleeve cotton pyjama set with knee-length shorts and white fluffy slippers
chars.NARRATOR: a skinny Moroccan teenage boy of 18 with short curly black hair, wearing a mustard yellow hoodie and grey joggers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Seen from a kitchen doorway in a modest Moroccan apartment in Casablanca: COUSIN steps out of her bedroom into the hallway mid-stride, head-to-waist framing, face visible, confident sly little smile, adjusting her loose hair. Warm morning light, calm plain background at the edges. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Small Moroccan kitchen with blue zellige tiles: NARRATOR stands at the stove heating a silver Moroccan teapot, yawning, bread and a plate of msemen on the counter, morning light. Head-to-waist framing, face visible. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. A bedroom door in a Moroccan apartment hallway swings open and COUSIN walks out in her pink pyjama, relaxed, swinging her arms, seen from the kitchen at the end of the hallway. Face visible, head-to-knees framing. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Moroccan kitchen: NARRATOR at the stove holding the teapot freezes with wide shocked eyes and dropped jaw, while COUSIN casually walks into the kitchen behind him opening the fridge. Comic shocked expression, both faces visible. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Close shot in the kitchen: NARRATOR quickly turns his head away and stares hard at the teapot on the stove, embarrassed, blushing red cheeks, sweat drop, comic awkward pose. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. NARRATOR leaning on the kitchen counter, scratching his head, confused thinking face, small cartoon question marks floating above his head, steam rising from the teapot beside him. No text or letters.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Moroccan kitchen: COUSIN leans on the doorframe with arms crossed, laughing teasingly and pointing at NARRATOR, who stands at the stove looking embarrassed and blushing. Both faces visible, light comic mood. No text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Moroccan apartment entrance hallway: the wooden front door shakes from loud heavy knocking (motion lines around it), COUSIN and NARRATOR both jump and spin toward it in panic, wide eyes. Both faces visible. No text.
